hooks.command: bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *pnpm-lock.yaml) echo "BLOCK: pnpm-lock.yaml は直接編集禁止。pnpm install を使ってください" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.jsx|*.js) ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot 2>&1 | tail -5;; esac; exit 0'
